Flood Insurance Data

Privacy Policy

Last updated October 22, 2026.

What we collect

Flood Insurance Data is a static reference site. We do not ask for, collect, or store personal information, and there are no accounts, sign-ups, or forms. Our host (Cloudflare) processes standard server request logs (such as IP address and user agent) to serve the site and protect it from abuse; see Cloudflare's privacy policy for details.

Cookies

This site sets no first-party tracking cookies of its own. If analytics or advertising are added in future (see below), the cookies and third-party vendors involved will be disclosed here before they are enabled.

Advertising

The site currently shows no ads. If advertising is added, it may be served by Google, including Google AdSense. Third-party vendors such as Google use cookies to serve ads based on a user's prior visits to this and other websites. Google's use of advertising cookies enables it and its partners to serve ads based on visits here and elsewhere. You may opt out of personalized advertising via Google Ads Settings, and review other options at aboutads.info. This section will be updated to name every ad vendor at the time ads are enabled.

Third-party data & links

All figures are compiled from public U.S. federal sources (FEMA OpenFEMA, the FEMA National Risk Index, and the U.S. Census Bureau). We link to official FEMA and Census pages; their privacy practices are their own. We are not affiliated with or endorsed by FEMA.

Children & changes

The site is not directed to children under 13 and collects no information from them. We may update this policy; material changes will be reflected by the date above.
